pages.name: notes
pages.description: Task notes on the task page: free text, web links tappable. Separate from body (the page's Write side, whose first line names the page).

pages.name: when
pages.description: Optional schedule date (yyyy-MM-dd). A page with a date shows on the Calendar tab; empty = unscheduled. Set via the page's schedule strip.

pages.name: whenTime
pages.description: Optional time of day for the schedule date, canonical HH:mm (24h). Empty = all day.

pages.name: scheduleKind
pages.description: What the schedule means: none (not scheduled), todo (can be checked done), appointment, or event.

pages.name: done
pages.description: A scheduled to-do is checked off (Calendar agenda checkbox or the schedule popup). Only meaningful when scheduleKind is todo.

pages.name: where
pages.description: Optional map pin as "lat, lng" (picked on the map). A page with a pin shows on the Map tab. Set via the page's place strip.

pages.name: place
pages.description: Optional human name for the page's place (e.g. "Seoul Station"). Set via the page's place strip, alongside the pin.

pages.name: entryKind
pages.description: What this page is on your timeline: a note, a journal entry, a task or an event — or a week's goal, or a habit you tick off on the Week page.

pages.name: groupId
pages.description: The agenda group this task sits in. Empty = no group.

pages.name: timerSeconds
pages.description: Countdown length in seconds. Empty = no countdown.

pages.name: timerEndsAt
pages.description: When a running countdown ends (UTC ISO). Empty = not running.

pages.name: timerLeft
pages.description: Seconds left on a paused countdown.

pages.name: timerSaved
pages.description: Seconds left on a countdown saved for later (Save for later / Resume). Only resume or discard changes it.

pages.name: timerFace
pages.description: Which face the task's timer shows: countdown (time left) or countup (time worked). One timer; switching never changes it.

pages.name: timerElapsed
pages.description: A stopwatch's (no target) elapsed seconds from earlier runs, for its count-up face. Time worked itself is in time_logs / trackedSeconds.

pages.name: trackStartedAt
pages.description: When the current tracking stretch started (UTC ISO). Empty = not tracking.

pages.name: doneAt
pages.description: When the task was ticked done (UTC ISO). Empty = not done. Carry-through ends the task's span on this day.

pages.name: trackedSeconds
pages.description: Total seconds tracked on this task.

pages.name: repeat
pages.description: How the task repeats: empty (never), weekly, daily, biweekly, monthlyDate, monthlyWeekday or yearly.

pages.name: repeatDays
pages.description: Weekdays for a weekly or every-2-weeks repeat.

pages.name: repeatDay
pages.description: Day of the month (1-31) for a monthly-on-a-date repeat.

pages.name: repeatNth
pages.description: Which weeks of the month (1st-4th or last) for a monthly-on-a-weekday repeat.

pages.name: repeatUntil
pages.description: The last day a repeating task may come back on (inclusive). Empty = it repeats forever (every task that repeated before this field existed).

pages.name: repeatFrom
pages.description: For a repeat occurrence: the id of the done task it came after. Keeps one next occurrence per done task.

pages.name: alarmSound
pages.description: The task alarm’s sound: empty (the default alarm tone), chime, bell, pulse or rise.

pages.name: groupIds
pages.description: Every agenda group this task sits in (it shows under each). groupId stays the primary group = the first entry; empty here means use groupId.

pages.name: aboutDate
pages.description: Optional — the day this entry is really about, if different from when you wrote it.

pages.name: emotion
pages.description: Overall feeling for this entry — decode it into named scores on the Feelings tab.

pages.name: partKind
pages.description: What kind of part this entry was migrated from (note, measurement, rich text, photo). Empty for ordinary entries.

pages.name: migratedFrom
pages.description: The entry part this entry was created from (entry_parts/<id>). Written once by the parts-to-entries migration.

pages.name: parkedKind
pages.description: The kind + agenda placement an item had before Turn into note / Turn into task, so converting back restores it. Local only.

tags.name: group
tags.description: Your own tag type, e.g. mood, project, place, habit — or person (shown as a round initials badge; a local label only, never a contact). Tags with the same type are grouped together.

tags.name: details
tags.description: Notes about this tag or person. Web links are tappable.

tags.name: usedAt
tags.description: When this tag was last used or created (UTC ISO). Newest first in the tag picker.

tags.name: groupIds
tags.description: The groups this tag (or person) belongs to, from the same list as task groups.

days.name: summary
days.description: How was the day, overall? A line about the whole day, separate from the individual entries.

days.name: gratitude
days.description: What you are grateful for that day. The Week page shows the week's lines; the day card shows the day's.

habit_ticks.description: The habit page this tick belongs to (side table keyed by its host page, like bubbles/bubble_links).

habit_ticks.name: date
habit_ticks.description: The day the habit was done (yyyy-MM-dd). One row per tick; un-ticking deletes the row.

people.name: quantity
people.description: A number that matters to you here — visits, calls, coffees…

feelings.name: entry
